summary: All 31 automated checks passed. I read sim.js against the Testpad and the specification and found no throw, freeze or unreachable-state defect in normal play. The Builder's notes say none of this was run by the Builder, so the playtest criteria and several emergent-behaviour criteria stay unverified for a human.

criteria.evidence: Checks load_sim and sim_is_pure. sim.js has an IIFE with module.exports and window.DummiesSim, and its rnd and rnd2 use mulberry32 on state.

Check params_match_spec: 250 parameters identical. PARAMS.impact holds perMomentum, maxPay, contactEps and pushClearance, with no maxClosing, yieldBase or yieldCurve. State params come from clone(PARAMS).
Checks walk_frame_rate_independent (203.2 vs 202.8 px) and run_speed_matches_spec. All speeds in PARAMS are px/s, and dummyStep and carsStep use dt.
Check deterministic_and_seeded. All spawn draws come from state.rng.
Check attract_then_confirm. createSim sets play when autostart is true. spawnStep returns at once when options.traffic is false.
Checks lunge_distance_equal_8_directions (164.0 in all 8 directions) and lunge_frame_rate_independent. dummyStep uses ease3 deltas with tn clamped to 1.
Check held_lunge_does_not_chain: 1 lunge. step() computes a fresh press from prevLunge and updates it every step.
Check lunge_distance_equal_8_directions covers the facing case. In dummyStep a lunge uses the held direction if one is held, otherwise d.facing, and facing starts at (0,-1).
Check lunge_eases_out: 87% at half time. Monotone speed follows from the easeOutCubic deltas in dummyStep.
Check recovery_is_tweened (0.35 s, moved 19.6 px). The easeOutQuad factor f is applied in dummyStep.
dummyStep clamps to the hall after both lunge and walk, and pushOut clamps again. No dedicated check ran.

Check level1_road_flows_left_to_right. The layout has lanes 284/336 and barriers at 214/406, and the top-left corner is clear (all road, shoulder and barrier geometry has x or y at 214 or above, or x at 354 or above). Read drawBarriers and limits.
Check level1_road_flows_left_to_right: 14 cars in 60 s, never stalls.
Check level2_cross_no_collisions: 18 horizontal, 24 vertical. drawEntry for the cross kind draws approach then lane, and only edges 0 and 2 exist. Read drawEntry and placeCar.
Checks level2_cross_no_collisions, level3_free_for_all and solid_cars_and_barriers_under_active_play. axisMove truncates every move against all other cars. The checks cover a limited number of seeds.

No named check covers give-way. Reading carsStep: the loop skips b.serial >= c.serial and skips lower-serial cars behind in the same lane band, and the lowest serial never yields. The scripted give-way and resume behaviour was not exercised.
Check level3_free_for_all: 4 directions, 6 classes. drawEntry draws lateral positions inside [200,520] and [200,800]. Full 12-unit pool coverage was not shown.
Checks level_progression and level1_road_flows_left_to_right (14 cars). spawnStep limits the pool to k < L.pool and stops at the allocation.
Check write_off_card_and_fresh_body. dismiss() resets the dummy and play resumes. The fresh-confirm test needs a new press (prevConfirm).
Checks level_progression, ending_decommissioned and ending_licensed. Priority order in levelEnd matches the specification.
Check ending_licensed. writeOff calls finish('licensed') when bodiesDestroyed >= 11.
Check rear_contact_pays_nothing. testImpact sets hit on every contact so each car pays at most once. reach is exactly 1 at full health.
Code review: index.html has no http(s) strings, loads sim.js with a script tag, and steps at 1/60 with an accumulator. Check html_static passed. Fonts name IBM Plex first with fallbacks.
Needs a playtest. By code, drawRoads, the level name in the HUD, the cards, the attract screen, the perception overlay and the restart button are all present. Math.random is used only for shake.
Playtest. Automated runs ended levels in 61 to 92 s, but quota feasibility needs a human.

Check damage_follows_momentum (sedan 374.0 vs 374.2, van 475.0 vs 474.5). testImpact uses min(maxPay, round(perMomentum*closing*mass*face)) and applies the same value to health and score. The check's 15% tolerance is loose, but the formula reads exact.
Code reading of testImpact: 1.65*138*1.0 = 227.7, which rounds to 228. Bus mass is 3.0, and a lunge peak speed of about 1640 px/s hits the 2300 cap. No dedicated automated check.
Checks dummy_cannot_walk_through_a_car and solid_cars_and_barriers_under_active_play. pushOut follows rule 3, with the nearestClear fallback.
No check. By code, the dummy is not an obstacle in axisMove and pushOut only moves the dummy, so cars are not altered.
Checks solid_cars_and_barriers_under_active_play and levels_always_end_with_dummy_in_traffic report no barrier crossing. limits() and latMove clamp lateral movement.
No dedicated check. By code, dummyStep ignores barriers and shoulders.
Check detection_commit_and_brake_flags shows a lock. Shoulder entry across a batch of seeds was not shown. By code, swFeasible allows tw inside the barrier limits.
Check levels_always_end_with_dummy_in_traffic (dummy at the road edges) passed with no barrier crossing. By code, an infeasible swerve sets stuck, which brakes. The exact scripted cases were not run.
Checks for no overlap on levels 1 to 3. latFree checks other cars and the level 3 oncoming bands, and spawnStep waits on oncoming bands in the hall kind.
Check levels_always_end_with_dummy_in_traffic: all levels ended in 61 to 92 s. Not run with the dummy at (60,60) specifically.
Playtest. By code, drawShoulders and drawBarriers draw a thick red-and-white barrier, with gaps at the level 2 crossing and none on level 3.
Playtest.
Check level2_cross_no_collisions. The code has no negative directions on level 2, and drawRoads draws forward arrows on level 2.
No dedicated check. Code: the lowest serial never yields and stallStep is present. The scripted junction cases were not run.
Check levels_always_end_with_dummy_in_traffic (all ended in 61 to 92 s) and solid_cars_and_barriers_under_active_play. The breaker count was not reported, so 'no breaker on level 2' is unproven.

Code reading of stallStep: it tracks the lowest-serial car L and runs after 6 s at speed < 1 while L.sees is false. It removes only higher serials that touch L or lie in L's sweep, and it changes neither vehiclesSpawned nor score nor bodiesDestroyed. No dedicated automated check.

defects.problem: On level 2 a higher-serial car already inside the junction yields to an approaching lower-serial car and can stop in that car's path. Both then hold until the stall breaker fires, and only if one of them has become the lowest serial. This follows the specified rule 3 and is covered by the backstop, so it is not a blocker.
A lunge is read from the held-key state at each step. A key tap shorter than one frame between steps would be lost, whereas the Testpad fired on the keydown event. Taps this short are unlikely.

notes: The Testpad's brief hit-stop (S.freeze) is not ported. Screen shake is kept. This is cosmetic and the specification does not list it.
Brake-first and infeasible-swerve cars brake to 0.55 of class speed, as in the Testpad. They do not stop dead, so the dummy can still be hit and pushed.
The calibration check's 15% tolerance is loose, but the code gives exact values.
The damage direction (inverse read as direct) and the one-way level 2 still need Lawrence's confirmation, as the specification states.
The licence sheet, learning dials, service, caution, hatch flip, endings and report bank are all present.
